decision_rule: Consultation 20 constrained composition and the battery R3-R5 / poles R7 line-check rules: a line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site, is misdated (board re-post stamp written as a first-posted date; aggregator or expired copy as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count, leads with an older fact (opening lines), rests on a premise no row states, carries pitch or Path claims, lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged; plants.csv must equal the evidence value. 'listed <date>' for a board stamp is allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17, run_log line 1140), so a re-list stamp written 'listed' is not misdated; ordering is not checked on bottleneck guesses. Every job board behind a line was re-read 2026-11-20 through its API (Workday CXS, Oracle requisitions, Paylocity pageData and JSON-LD, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Dayforce rendered board); every cited role is still listed. News, company and government quotes behind line facts re-checked with fetch_page --check: all FOUND.
